title: push-00 L124: invalidArguments not a SetError
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-push-00 L124 says an unsupported urgency is rejected with invalidArguments, but RFC 8620 defines invalidArguments only as a method-level error (rfc8620.txt ~1189), not among the /set SetErrors (~2099-2159). crate-jmap returns invalidProperties naming chatPush/<accountId>/urgency (decision D4). Fix the draft text to invalidProperties. Raised by crate-jmap JMAP-nbk3 plan (approved 2026-10-19).
notes: 2026-10-19 spec gap audit: the same invalidArguments-as-SetError problem also appears in chat-00 L656/L1732 and Scene/VTC SetError tables; tracked together in jmap-chat-spec-up1n.
close_reason: Fixed in 91672c9: push-00 L124/L127 now invalidProperties naming chatPush/<id>/urgency and mentionUrgency.
